findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_market_state" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Current DAMO market state of one symbol across 10 timeframes: state name and permanent code per timeframe, plus a 10-value vector in fixed timeframe order." → after: "Use when the user asks about the current market state (trend or momentum) of a crypto asset on any timeframe from 1 minute to 1 month. Returns state data only: no prices, forecasts or trade signals. Current DAMO market state of one symbol across 10 timeframes: state name and permanent code per timef"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
